name: Ioun Stone (Reserve)

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Cast a stored spell
powers.text: Cast a spell stored in the stone.

powers.name: Store a spell
powers.text: Outside a fight, a spellcaster casts a spell of level 1 to 3 into it (up to 3 levels).

summary: Stores up to 3 levels of spells cast into it, for you to cast.
text: Once you are attuned, toss this stone upward as a Magic action and it circles your head 1d3 feet away, granting its benefit while it orbits; snatching it back out of the air takes an action. The stones bear the name of Ioun, a deity of knowledge and prophecy worshipped on some worlds. Benefit: it keeps spells that are cast into it, 3 spell levels at most, and you can cast them from it.
